info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Loyalty programs API

items.docs: Returns all loyalty programs of the enterprise, optionally filtered by specific loyalty program identifiers, activity states, or other filter parameters. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Adds loyalty programs to the enterprise. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
Updates information about the specified loyalty programs. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
Deletes loyalty programs. Note that a loyalty program containing active memberships cannot be deleted.
